key_highlights: ASX treads water amid persistent interest-rate fears; Bullock hawkishness at RBA signals higher-for-longer policy (#44, #53, #56)
Iron ore downside persists, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; China demand concerns ahead of Trump-Xi summit (#51, #31)
Sydney housing market in 'bloodbath' with auction reality check, weighing on REITs and bank credit growth (#52, #65)
Active WA/SA gold exploration: Broken Hill lifts SA resource, Great Southern hits 10.72g/t, Forrestania and Platina expand WA ground (#41, #49, #46, #36)
Super contributions surge >33% post-budget tax changes; new government-backed digital pension scheme proposed (#62, #67)
ASIC warns private credit investors may bail; corporate cop sues Super Retail boss over market misleading (#3, #45)
Diesel/petrol price shock rising, pressuring transport and consumer staples (#54)
Trump-Xi summit anticipation drives global risk-on; silver rising, oil falling (#9, #31)

sectors.trend: Iron ore weakness dominates; gold exploration active in WA/SA with multiple positive drill results. Rare earths (Dalaroo) and antimony-gold (Larvotto) show diversification.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from iron ore downside. Gold juniors (PLA.AX, FOR.AX, GSO.AX) and Broken Hill (BHP.AX) benefit from exploration upside. Silver rising pre-summit supports silver-exposed miners.

sectors.trend: Housing correction in Sydney pressures credit growth and NIMs. Higher-for-longer RBA stance supports NIMs but caps loan volumes. Super contribution surge benefits fund managers.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face mixed signals: rate support vs. credit risk from housing. Super funds (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) benefit from 33%+ contribution surge. ASIC private credit warning adds regulatory overhang.

sectors.trend: Diesel and petrol price shock rising; oil falling pre-Trump-Xi summit. EV adoption accelerating in Australia.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX face margin pressure from fuel cost volatility. Long-term EV transition (head #68) threatens liquid fuel demand. LNG exporters (WDS.AX, GWO.AX) relatively insulated.

sectors.trend: Sydney housing 'bloodbath' and auction reality check signal cooling. Rental market disruption proposed (cutting out agents).
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICV.AX) face occupancy and yield pressure. Retail REITs (SRG.AX, VMC.AX) under pressure from consumer caution. Rental yield compression possible.

sectors.trend: NDIS funding failures highlighted; EV adoption shifting consumer spend. Consumer staples under pressure from fuel costs.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX offer defensive stability. Fuel cost shock (#54) pressures WES.AX, WOW.AX margins. NDIS policy risk affects healthcare service providers.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; favour rate-sensitive banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX) for NIM benefit; underweight growth REITs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price decline / China demand weakness
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and diversified miners; monitor Trump-Xi summit outcome

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Sydney housing correction spilling into credit losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor bank NPL trends; favour diversified lenders (CBA.AX) over Sydney-heavy exposure; underweight property REITs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fuel price shock / energy cost inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour energy producers (WDS.AX, GWO.AX) over consumers; monitor WES.AX, WOW.AX margin guidance
Avoid illiquid private credit exposures; favour listed, transparent instruments; monitor corporate cop actions

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical escalation (Trump trade war, German instability)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain gold allocation (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX); diversify away from China-exposed miners; hold AUD-hedged positions

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore / China-exposed materials weight
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore downside persists; Trump-Xi summit uncertainty; structural China demand concerns
Housing bloodbath, auction reality check, and potential rental market disruption threaten occupancy and yields

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain defensive healthcare and consumer staples allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX offer resilience amid rate uncertainty and fuel cost shock
Trump trade war and global growth risk could pressure AUD and commodity prices

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound ('treads water') with rate fears and iron ore weakness capping upside. Trump-Xi summit outcome is the key binary catalyst. Housing data and RBA commentary will drive volatility. Expect 1-2% range on ^AXJO.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from iron ore cycle, housing correction, and higher-for-longer rates cap ASX 200 upside. Gold, healthcare, and super infrastructure offer relative outperformance. 6-12 month outlook cautiously neutral with sector rotation away from materials into defensives.
